line_items.reasoning: Q1 2025 revenue came in at $884M, exceeding the guided range of $858M–$862M by ~$22M–$26M (~350 bps above the high end), a clear beat.
U.S. commercial revenue hit $255M in Q1 alone (a $1B+ annualized run rate), growing 71% YoY and already tracking well above the full-year 2025 guidance of >$1.079B at 54% YoY growth.
Adjusted operating margin reached 44% in Q1, already above the full-year 2025 guided range of ~41–42%, representing 800 bps of YoY expansion despite flagged increases in operating expenses.

Q1 adjusted free cash flow of $370M at a 42% margin puts PLTR on pace to exceed the full-year 2025 guidance of $1.5B–$1.7B, tracking toward ~$1.48B annualized at the low end but with typical back-half seasonality suggesting upside.
GAAP net income was positive in Q1 2025 ($0.08 EPS), fulfilling the commitment to GAAP profitability each quarter of 2025, with adjusted EPS of $0.13 further demonstrating operational strength.
